messages:
ben_sales: Heads up — ACME asked for a private offer: 12mo commit. Thinking 25% off Hosted + 30% off Dedicated year1. Anyone see issues?

sara_partnerships: can we fold HW/appliance credit in with the offer? pinging @marta_ops for ops/credit constraints. :eyes:

marta_ops: we can do a 3mo ramp onboarding credit (appliance or ops) but need a $150k minimum commit. also we need a renewal floor and clear SLA handoff.

oliver_legal: flag: add a phased rollback if utilization < 60% after 6mo. also need marketplace parity language and data residency clause for their gov workload.

jade_pricing: alternative structure: slab discounts — 0-500k = 20%, 500k-1M = 25%, >1M = 30%. include onboarding credit and 90-day price protection for renewals. simpler for finance to model.

ben_sales: ACME will prefer simpler. propose: flat 25% off public list, include 3mo onboarding credit capped at $30k, and if they cross >1M give a 30% renewal incentive.

sara_partnerships: must check marketplace rules — private offer can't undercut public listing by >10% on AWS/GCP marketplace policy. if flat 25% breaks parity we need an exception or adjust.

oliver_legal: confirmed — AWS policy requires parity guardrails. we'll add clause: "Marketplace parity fallback: in case of marketplace policy conflict Redwood reserves right to align private offer pricing within 10% of public listing." i'll draft wording.

marketplace-bot: Private offer template v2 uploaded to /docs/marketplace/private-offers/v2 — includes parity clause, sample rollback language, and billing SKU mapping.

ben_sales: ok next steps — i will draft the PO using the flat 25% + $30k onboarding credit + >1M renewal kicker. @marta_ops confirm ops can support ramp credits and min commit $150k. @oliver_legal to finalize clause. target: send draft to ACME by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:

marta_ops: confirmed on support and $150k min. will add an ops runbook snippet for onboarding to the PO.

oliver_legal: will drop final clause by Thursday noon.

ben_sales: great — thanks team. once legal final, i'll route to pricing for sign-off and then marketplace listing review.

sara_partnerships: looping in finance next: @jade_pricing can you run net revenue / margin scenario for both slab and flat options? need numbers for renewal modeling.

jade_pricing: yep i'll have a short model by Thursday close. will include sensitivity to churn and uplift assumptions.
